zone_geometry.numeric_polygon_hole_policy: public numeric arrays store exterior vertices only; holes are filled in the proxy polygon and must not be interpreted as exact collision regions
zone_geometry.zone_geometry_semantics: branch-specific public movement corridor intersections; lane centerlines are buffered by half declared lane width with flat ends; merge corridors include only one exit-lane-width after convergence; only exactly equal polygons are deduplicated
zone_geometry.entry_clearance_semantics: computed from actor-oriented rectangular footprint sweep along each public lane polyline; static zone remains a lane-corridor proxy, not an exact collision label
